documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Srivari Spices and Foods Limited held its H1 FY26 earnings conference call, reporting robust revenue and PAT growth alongside stable EBITDA margins. Management discussed product category contributions from Atta, Spices, and newly launched Oil, as well as upcoming diversification into Soya Chunks and a puja/devotional goods vertical. The company plans to prioritize portfolio expansion within its home states of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana rather than incurring heavy costs in new geographies. Furthermore, leadership expressed confidence in sustaining growth momentum through the second half of the financial year. Srivari Spices and Foods Limited published its investor presentation for H1 FY26, highlighting business evolution, brand milestones, and financial performance.

guidance.claim: Management stated they are confident of sustaining the growth momentum in the second half of the year.
guidance.quote: The demand environment continues to be encouraging and we are confident of sustaining the growth momentum in the second half.

guidance.claim: Management expects FY27 to be the best in their past complete history.
guidance.quote: As I said, new products are launched, so might be 100% will achieve. Exactly, I can't comment on that. But it will be better than, FY '27 will be the best in our past complete history.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand environment continues to be encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment continues to be encouraging and we are confident of sustaining the growth momentum in the second half.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the groundnut oil category has very little competition.
demand_outlook.quote: No. In fact, we do not have much competition in general in this groundnut oil. Very less brands are there in the pure groundnut oil.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that over 70 percent of Indians do not consume the recommended daily protein intake.
demand_outlook.quote: Over 70% of Indians do not consume the recommended daily protein intake (Source: Indian Market Research Bureau).

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of approximately 6 percent from 2024 to 2029.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of ~6% from 2024 –2029, driven by rising health awareness and higher protein consumption.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that 70% of the spices market is unorganized trade and is shifting toward organized trade.
demand_outlook.quote: As I said, one important thing is in the spices, still 70% is an unorganized trade.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that 70% of atta is unorganized loose atta.
demand_outlook.quote: As well as atta is also same, 70% is in the loose atta which is unorganized.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they are planning to introduce a new business vertical focused on puja articles, devotional goods, and festival items.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we are planning to introduce a new business vertical focused on manufacturing, trading and distribution of puja articles, devotional goods, festival related items and allied products.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they are planning geographical expansion into Gujarat, Karnataka, and Odisha.
The company launched a new oil plant and officially introduced its products in Mumbai, Maharashtra on July 28, 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: Launched a new oil plant and officially introduced its products in Mumbai, Maharashtra on 28 July 2025 .

margins_costs.claim: Management reported an EBITDA margin of 17.05% and PAT margin of 9.14% for the first half of FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Our profitability remained healthy with EBITDA margin of 17.05% and PAT margin of 9.14%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the oil division is currently at EBITDA breakeven.
margins_costs.quote: No, exactly breakeven only, not in the losses.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that monthly media channel expenditure is around Rs. 5-6 lakhs.
margins_costs.quote: So, altogether monthly we are spending Rs. 5-Rs. 6 lakhs on the media channels, new media channels.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 17.05 percent for H1 FY26.
Management stated that net profit decreased due to the new plant commencement and claiming depreciation for six months.
margins_costs.quote: See PAT has been decreased due to the new plant commencement and we have claimed the depreciation of the 6 months because of that PAT has been decreased, but our overall numbers are positive.

orders_capacity.claim: Management provided installed capacity and utilization figures for Spices, Atta, and Oil.
orders_capacity.quote: For Spices, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons and we have utilized 2,637 tons. And when it comes to Atta, installed capacity is 14,400 tons and we have utilized 12,650 tons. When it comes to Oil, we have installed capacity of 7,200 tons and we have utilized 720 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed capacity for spices and masalas is 3,600 tons per annum with a current utilization of 2,637 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: For spices and masalas, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons per annum with the current utilization at about 2,637 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed capacity for atta is 14,400 tons per annum with a utilization of 12,650 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: When it comes to atta, 14,400 tons per annum installed capacity and we have utilized 12,650 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed capacity for oil is 7,200 tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Regarding oil, we have installed capacity of 7,200 tons per annum but this plant is yet to be commercialized.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated they would utilize bank debt if needed for expansion.
capital_allocation.quote: If we need exactly, we will go for the debts of the bankers.

capital_allocation.claim: Rights shares were issued on October 10, 2024 to enhance the capital structure.
capital_allocation.quote:
Rights Shares issued on 10th Oct,
2024 to enhance capital structure.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the entire amount raised from the rights issue was utilized for specified purposes without deviation.
capital_allocation.quote: So, as disclosed in the letter of offer, we have utilized the entire amount for the specified purpose without any deviation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that expanding into new states like Maharashtra involves a tough time and high advertising budgets.
risks_headwinds.quote: Because brands have already acquired 42 from last 25, 30, 40 years. So, it will take a lot of time for the placement also. And second thing is, we have to put a lot of budget on the advertisement, if you go for the new state.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that growth targets were not reached last year due to challenges of a new setup and a delay in rights.
risks_headwinds.quote: Yes, as we have in the earlier this investor's meet we have committed some growth percentage and we didn't reach out in the last year that we do because of the challenges of this new setup.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the puja and devotional products vertical is scheduled to be launched in January.
management_commitments.quote: In Jan, roughly in the Jan, we are going to launch.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they plan to evaluate installation of manufacturing capacities for Soya Chunks after two quarters.
management_commitments.quote: Install the capacity later, after 2 quarters.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated they plan to target export markets in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Next year, we will plan for the expansion. Next year, we are into the planning for that.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets reaching up to 30% utilization in the oil segment in H2.
management_commitments.quote: I think next financial year, H2 will be utilized almost 30% easily. We can reach up to 30%. Now, we can utilize up to 30% in this H2.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that all oil products will be placed in complete marketplaces by the end of the month.
management_commitments.quote: All the oil product will be placed in the complete marketplaces.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
